$comment: Owner review registry for the time-sensitive public copy (Issue #437). One entry per public expression that points at *now*: when the owner last read it, what kind of review it was, and what the expression was checked against. The gate (scripts/check-stale-content-review.mjs) matches the registry against the text of the public copy surfaces — so editing a sentence invalidates its record and the sentence waits for a review again. The registry is owner data, not an application obligation: it is read by the gate and written by the owner.
policy: A review date means: the owner read this expression on this day and confirmed that it still says what it says. The freshness window is the span after which the record is treated as waiting for a re-read; it is a reading interval, not a truth interval. The gate may do exactly three things: report which expressions carry a record, report which expressions are waiting for a review, and report which locales were not examined. The gate may NOT decide that an expression is untrue, may NOT remove a sentence from the publication, may NOT propose a replacement wording, and may NOT publish anything. Unpublishing is an owner decision that this repository cannot make for the owner.
